messages:
Ava: Heads up: staging canary failed consistently on auth-service e2e after the last merge. Seeing 401s on refresh endpoint since 13:12 UTC.

Ravi: Can you paste the failing assertion? quick check if it's flaky or deterministic pls. :thinking_face: 

Ava: ```
FAIL tests/e2e/test_token_rotation.py::test_refresh_flow
E AssertionError: expected status 200 but got 401
E Request POST /internal/auth/refresh body={"refresh_token":"***"}
E Response headers: {"x-cache-status":"HIT", "x-cache-ttl":"-1"}
```

Noah: x-cache-ttl -1 = expired/stale fixture from remote CI fixture cache. We pushed a token payload change earlier today. If CI returns old fixture the refresh will 401.

Ava: Reran job with cache disabled: `CI_FIXTURE_CACHE=0 ./ci/run-staging-e2e.sh` -> all green. So cache path reproduces failure 5/5.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: failing check `staging-e2e` (job 6801122501). Auto-rollback not enabled for this pipeline.

Ravi: Two immediate choices: a) pin to last-known-good image (sha256:cc33dd44) and manual promote, or b) revert the token-format change. Pin is faster for the release window. Thoughts?

Noah: Pin + evict cache seems safest. I can run eviction: `tools/ci/invalidate-fixtures --svc=auth-service --env=staging` (takes ~2-4m). After eviction we should re-run the canary.

Ava: If we pin, add a release-note callout and schedule an unpin after change window. Also create a follow-up ticket for fixing TTL handling.

Ravi: I'm oncall. I approve pin + manual promote. I'll do steps now:
1) `deploybot promote --image=sha256:cc33dd44 --env=staging --manual`
2) run `tools/ci/invalidate-fixtures --svc=auth-service --env=staging`
3) `./ci/retry-job 6801122501`

ci-bot: Manual promote initiated by Ravi. Canary replaced with image sha256:cc33dd44 (see https://ci.internal/6801122501).

Ava: Canary re-run passed after eviction. Staging e2e all green.

Noah: Creating follow-up RD ticket now: RD-5501 "auth-service CI fixture cache TTL regression". Assigning to Platform team, P1 post-release. Adding logs and x-cache-ttl evidence.

Ravi: Adding release notes line: "auth-service pinned to last-known-good image due to CI fixture cache TTL regression; will unpin after maintenance and TTL fix (see RD-5501)."

Ava: Confirmed promotion completed. Release window unblocked. Thanks team. :tada:

Noah: Postmortem reminder: add CI-level assertion to fail if `x-cache-ttl` < 0 and document manual cache eviction steps in ops runbook.

Ravi: I'll draft a short runbook entry for manual eviction and include command examples and expected timings.

deploy-bot: Promotion completed by Ravi. Release allowed to proceed.
